release_milestone: The execution owner reports lossless raw collection and preregistered adjudication complete for the approved campaign, or the human supplies a new instruction.
evidence_boundary: Run results determine workflow order. Deterministic real-algebraic and topological claims require their own proofs independently of QPU frequencies.

lemmas.name: polynomial_generic_rank
lemmas.conclusion: Outside a finite polynomial exceptional set the matrix rank equals the certified generic rank.

lemmas.name: orthogonal_projector_removable_limit
lemmas.conclusion: The rational kernel projector extends through every real endpoint and its limit has the generic rank and lies in the endpoint kernel.

lemmas.name: persistent_chart_radius
premises: nonzero constant term after removing endpoint factor
lemmas.conclusion: The recorded rational radius excludes every other exceptional parameter and certifies the persistent frame.

lemmas.name: unit_incidence_closure
lemmas.conclusion: The closure fiber equals the unit sphere of the limiting projector range.

lemmas.name: three_coefficient_cone_ranks
lemmas.conclusion: Nullities are zero off A^2+B^2=C^2, eight on its punctured cone, and twelve at its vertex.

lemmas.name: cone_kernel_bundle_and_attachment
lemmas.conclusion: The rank-eight kernel bundle has complete global frames; its limiting planes are C4 plus a circle of rotating four-planes.

lemmas.name: cone_attachment_image
premises: complete endpoint decomposition C4 plus R4 plus R4
lemmas.conclusion: The unit-partner attachment image is homeomorphic to S3*(S1 x S3). Integral homology occurs in degrees zero,five,seven,eight; torsion and positive cup products vanish.

lemmas.name: cone_total_incidence_retraction
lemmas.conclusion: Two mapping cylinders describe the restricted incidence and an explicit strong deformation retraction identifies its homotopy type as S11.

lemmas.name: quaternion_automorphism_doubling
lemmas.conclusion: Diagonal extension is an orthogonal Cayley-Dickson automorphism at every higher stage.

lemmas.name: ordinary_embedding_attachment_induction
lemmas.conclusion: Projectors, persistent and endpoint kernels, and attachment maps double through every stage. The named cone family has common dimension p=2^(n-3), attachment image S^(p-1)*(S1 x S^(p-1)), and total-incidence homotopy S^(3p-1).

remaining_ambient_obligations: Classify unrestricted real rank loci, including all coefficient directions.
Construct compatible smooth strata and prove their coverage.
Determine every frontier, kernel limit and local link in the complete pair space.
Construct a certified finite global topological model with explicit gluing maps.
Compute unrestricted integral homology, torsion, cohomology products and selected homotopy invariants.
Port the admitted lemmas into Rocq after the run-results workflow milestone.
